items.title: Pay final electricity invoice
items.quote: Der Rechnungsbetrag ist innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug zur Zahlung fällig.
items.computation: Rechnungsdatum is 14.04.2026. The period is counted 'nach dem Rechnungsdatum', so per §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the invoice date itself is not counted and the period starts on 15.04.2026 (day 1). Counting 30 days: 15.04.-30.04. = 16 days, remaining 14 days run 01.05.-14.05.2026, so day 30 falls on 14.05.2026. However, 14.05.2026 is Christi Himmelfahrt (Ascension Day, Easter Sunday 05.04.2026 + 39 days), a statutory public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen. Under §193 BGB, when the last day of a period falls on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday, it is replaced by the next business day, i.e. Friday 15.05.2026.
